_comment: Pinned program for 'How many players are visible?' on the best-goal clip. Chain frames->people->n->result ends count->answer (an op-path the hero chain never hits). A SINGLE-frame window (12125-12126ms @ 1fps -> exactly ts 12125, a detect key in best-goal_cache.json) so count grounds to the per-frame person count (5), not a multi-frame sum. 12125 is inside the clip's duration_ms (30087). Validates against ../schema/dsl.schema.json.
